paragraphs.text: Chrome-style tabs for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web chat sessions: tab strip, tab groups, split panes.
# dsh-tabs

Chrome-style tabs for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
chat sessions, in the Web GUI.

- **A tab strip in your order.** Opening a chat adds a tab at the end. Only opening, closing and
dra

gging change the order; switching tabs never moves one.
- **Vertical or horizontal.** Down the side

(drag its edge to resize it, 180–560 px) or along the
top like a browser.
- **Tab groups.** Each has

a name and a colour and can be collapsed. "Group by project" builds
them from the chats' workspaces

.
- **Splits.** A tab holds one session or up to four live panes side by side. Drag a tab onto a
pan

e's edge to split it, or onto its centre to replace or swap it.
- **Nothing stops.** Closing a tab o

nly takes it off the strip: the session keeps running in
DSH's session list (the drawer), and ⌥⇧T re

opens it.
- **Notifications.** A bell collects one notification per question from any open tab, and

you
can answer short ones right there. ☾ Focus turns off the banners.
- **Subagents and jobs.** A ch

ip in each pane's header lists them; click a subagent to open it
beside the pane.

The page appears as **Tabs** in the sidebar. Files, Terminal and file previews open on the
session's
normal full page (⤢); **Back to tabs** returns.
## Install
Requires DSH with the Web GUI (`dsh web`).

Or from a clone, to hack on it:

Then restart `dsh web` and refresh the page. The bundle adds its own profile row
(`cordis.patch.yml`

); the only option is `stateFile` (default
`~/.dsh/dsh-tabs/state.json`).
## Shortcuts
| Keys | Action |

| ⌥1 … ⌥8, ⌥9 | Tab n, the last tab |
| ⌥[ ⌥] | Previous / next tab |
| ⌥O | Open a recent chat |
|

⌥W | Close the focused pane |
| ⌥⇧T | Reopen the last closed tab |
| ⌥←↑↓→ | Move focus between pane

s |
| ⌥F | Full page of the focused pane |
| ⌥B | Show or hide the drawer |
| ⌥N | Notifications |
They also appear in DSH's shortcut reference. **?** on the page explains the mouse actions.
## For other plugins
dsh-tabs declares two slots that other bundles may fill:
| Slot | Kind | Shows |
| `tabs.menubar.item` | list, root scope | A small item on the page's menu bar (for example a usage

gauge). |
| `tabs.pane.side` | keyed, session scope | A side panel inside a pane, opened from the pa
`tabs.pane.side` | keyed, session scope | A side panel inside a pane, opened from the pane header. |
Inject them with `ctx.slots.inject('<slot>', () => ctx.slots.register({ name: '<slot>', … }, Compone

nt))`
so your bundle waits until dsh-tabs is loaded and works without it.
## Development

Plain JavaScript, no build step: `index.js` is the Host half (the state file and its
route) and `cli

ent.js` is the Client half (the page). See DESIGN.md for
how they work.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
After a change to `client.js`, refresh the page. A change to `index.js` needs a DSH restart.
